body.purpose: Carries service descriptions and relationship notes.

components.name: Service node
components.description: A labelled actor or service with concise supporting copy.
components.css: .ds-service-node { background: #ffffff; border: 1.5px solid #c7d2d7; border-radius: 12px; padding: 22px; color: #18252c; font-family: Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif; } .ds-service-node strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 25px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-service-node span { display: block; color: #52636d; font-size: 21px; line-height: 29px; }

components.name: Host frame
components.description: An enclosure grouping one host heading and its guest nodes.
components.css: .ds-host-frame { box-sizing: border-box; background: #ffffff; border: 1.5px solid #aebfc7; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; color: #18252c; font-family: Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif; width: 720px; height: 650px; } .ds-host-frame strong { display: block; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-host-frame span, .ds-host-frame div { color: #52636d; font-size: 22px; } .ds-host-frame hr { border: 0; border-top: 1.5px solid #c7d2d7; margin: 16px 0; }

narrative.overview: This visual system applies to the static architecture sheets in this directory. It uses a cool paper field, plain sans-serif labels, fine strokes and measured spacing so containment and relationships remain easy to follow. Color is reserved for grouping and selected paths; geometry carries the explanation.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed landscape sheets composed from editable SVG geometry.
Blue grouping and teal relationship accents against quiet neutrals.
Static, flat presentation with no generated imagery or external assets.

rules.name: The Color-Has-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Keep blue for grouping and teal for selected relationships; use neutrals for most text and structure.

dos: Do keep the page title, group headings and supporting copy in the established sans-serif hierarchy.
Do use containment, whitespace and orthogonal lines to make relationships readable.
Do reserve the two accent colors for grouping and selected paths.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, motion, icon libraries or generated imagery.
Don't use accent colors as decoration or introduce an additional palette.
Don't turn the sheets into a dashboard or add interactive controls.
